# Security Checklist: Base de dados (data-base)

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade dos requisitos de segurança da 004 (leitura por fatias sem efeito no jogo, código do jogo só em processo isolado, `_vars` em lista fechada perto do token de login, nada do jogo no repositório) antes do plano
**Created**: 2026-11-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: Standard · Audience: Reviewer (PR)

## Leitura no jogo em execução

- [x] CHK001 Is property-only reading stated for the continuous reading, excluding getters and `JSON.stringify` on game objects? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Is it stated that nothing stays resident in the game's page between readings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Is the read-only proof required for the reading, with a fake engine and no game open? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are writing to the save, automating clicks and calling a game function excluded in the running game? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Memória perto do token de login

- [x] CHK005 Is the reading of `_vars` limited to a closed list of keys, with a limit on the objects inspected? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK006 Is it stated that nothing outside the list is kept or logged, with a test using a fake token? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK007 Is the state copy kept only in memory, out of the disk and of `keeper.log`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Código do jogo em processo isolado

- [x] CHK008 Is the exception to "never run the game's file" limited to one new isolated module, with the 003 rule kept for its files, and an ADR required? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009, §Dependências]
- [x] CHK009 Is it defined how the game's code has no path to the network, given that code isolation alone is not a security barrier? [Gap, Spec §Deixado para quem construir, §Open Questions]
- [x] CHK010 Are the blocks that write or save excluded in the isolated copy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK011 Is the calculation kept out of the keeper, so its failure cannot close the game? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK012 Is the constitution amendment a documented dependency that lands before the code? [Dependency, Spec §Dependências]

## Repositório e dados

- [x] CHK013 Are `N.js` and `default.pak` excluded from the repository and the installer? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK014 Are player names and excerpts of the game's file excluded from tests? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK015 Is network access excluded outside the app's updater? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK009: fica para o plano (Open Questions, `to plan`).
